title: Workout log
audience: For anyone training a few times a week who wants to see progress.
description: A workout log in one table. Describe the session after training and your AI logs it, and keeps your personal bests.
tagline: A row per session, and your bests.
note:
Workout log

One row per session. Add it yourself, or tell your AI what you did after training and it logs it.

## Sessions
<!-- pane-table: Date=date; Workout=choice Push|Pull|Legs|Run|Other; Exercise=text; Result=text; Effort (1–10)=scale 1-10 -->
| Date | Workout | Exercise | Result | Effort (1–10) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Program
Legs, push and pull in turn with a day between, and an easy run on a rest day.
- Legs: squat, lunges, calves
- Push: bench press, overhead press, dips
- Pull: deadlift, rows, pull-ups

## Personal bests
Your best result for each exercise, with its date.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Workout log". Read it with fetch before each change. After a session I'll tell you what I did. Add one row to the table with edit: Workout as one of the options, the main Exercise, the Result like "100 kg x 5" or "5 km in 29 min", and Effort from 1 to 10. If I beat a result listed under "Personal bests", or there's none for that exercise yet, add it there with today's date. When I ask how I'm doing, compare the last four weeks.

asks: Ask how today's workout went and how hard it felt, then log the session.
Am I getting stronger on bench?
What did I do last Wednesday?
